title: bistorta suffulta var. suffultoides
intro: Bistorta suffulta var. suffultoides, commonly known as Alpine bistort, is a plant species in the buckwheat family, Polygonaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing relief from respiratory issues. The health benefits of Alpine bistort are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as astringent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which are mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The therapeutic actions of Alpine bistort may also be beneficial for its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
